name: Real-Time Fraud & Risk Intelligence Platform
tagline: Scores every payment in milliseconds and explains every block.
problem: Digital payments such as UPI and cards move in seconds, and fraud moves with them. Rule engines miss new patterns and flood analysts with false alarms.
realtime: Each transaction is scored as it streams in, within a sub-100 ms budget; risky ones are held, challenged or blocked before money leaves the account.
modules: Streaming feature pipeline on transaction events (Kafka + feature store)
Gradient-boosted risk model with SHAP reason codes for every decision
Graph neural network that uncovers mule accounts and fraud rings
LLM analyst copilot that summarises cases and drafts suspicious-transaction reports
Model governance pack: drift monitoring, fairness tests and audit trail for regulators
context: UPI, cards, net banking, RBI and DPDP Act compliance

name: Clinical Decision & Medical Imaging Copilot
tagline: Triage scans, summarise records and flag risk, with the doctor in control.
problem: Specialists are scarce outside big cities, scans wait in queues, and patient histories are scattered across reports.
realtime: Scans are triaged as they are uploaded and urgent cases jump the queue; bedside vitals stream to early-warning models that alert care teams.
modules: Deep-learning triage for retinal, chest X-ray and CT images with heat-map explanations
RAG assistant over patient records and clinical guidelines with cited answers
Early-warning score from streaming vitals at the edge
Federated learning so hospitals train together without sharing patient data
Clinician-in-the-loop review, consent and audit log
context: ABDM health records, tele-ophthalmology, hospital PACS

name: Smart Factory Quality & Predictive Maintenance Suite
tagline: Catch every defect on the line and fix machines before they fail.
problem: Manual inspection misses defects and unplanned downtime halts production lines at great cost.
realtime: Cameras inspect every part at line speed on edge devices; vibration and temperature sensors raise maintenance alerts before failure.
modules: Edge vision inspection for surface and assembly defects
TinyML anomaly detection on vibration and acoustic sensors
Remaining-useful-life forecasting for critical machines
Digital twin of the line for what-if simulation
Reinforcement-learning scheduler that re-plans jobs around breakdowns
context: Automotive, electronics, pharma and steel plants; Make in India lines

name: Real-Time Personalisation & Conversational Commerce Engine
tagline: The right product, price and answer for every shopper, in the moment.
problem: Generic catalogues and static prices lose shoppers; support teams cannot answer millions of questions in many languages.
realtime: Recommendations and offers update with every click; a shopping agent answers, compares and orders in the customer's language.
modules: Session-based recommender updated from live click streams
Reinforcement-learning dynamic pricing and offer optimisation
Generative product descriptions and images at catalogue scale
Multilingual shopping agent that searches, compares and places orders
A/B experimentation and guardrails against unfair pricing
kpis: Support tickets resolved by the agent
context: Marketplaces, quick commerce, ONDC sellers, D2C brands

name: Autonomous Supply-Chain Control Tower
tagline: See every shipment, predict every delay, act before customers notice.
problem: Demand swings, traffic and stock-outs break plans every day, and teams react by phone and spreadsheet.
realtime: Live GPS, warehouse and order events feed forecasts and route optimisers; agents re-route, re-allocate stock and notify customers automatically.
modules: Demand forecasting by SKU and location
Route and fleet optimisation with live traffic
Warehouse robotics coordination for picking and sorting
Exception-handling agents that re-plan and inform customers
Blockchain traceability for high-value and cold-chain goods
context: 3PLs, e-commerce fulfilment, ports, cold chain, PM Gati Shakti corridors

name: AIOps Self-Healing Network Platform
tagline: Detect, diagnose and fix network faults before subscribers call.
problem: 5G networks produce billions of telemetry events; outages are found late and diagnosed by hand.
realtime: Telemetry streams are scanned for anomalies continuously; agents diagnose root cause and trigger approved remediation runbooks.
modules: Streaming anomaly detection on network KPIs and logs
Root-cause analysis over the network topology graph
Remediation agents with human approval for risky actions
Churn prediction and next-best-offer for subscribers
Quantum-safe cryptography readiness assessment
context: 5G operators, ISPs, data centres, network equipment makers

name: Smart Grid Forecasting & Optimisation Platform
tagline: Balance a grid full of solar, wind and EVs, minute by minute.
problem: Renewables and electric vehicles make supply and demand volatile; manual dispatch wastes energy and money.
realtime: Smart-meter and weather streams drive short-term forecasts; optimisers schedule storage, demand response and dispatch every few minutes.
modules: Load and solar/wind generation forecasting
Reinforcement-learning control for batteries and demand response
Edge analytics on smart meters and substations
Theft and loss detection from meter data
Quantum and classical optimisation pilot for unit commitment
context: DISCOMs, solar parks, EV charging networks, smart-meter roll-outs

name: Precision Agriculture Intelligence Platform
tagline: From satellite and drone to a farmer's phone, in their own language.
problem: Small farmers decide on water, fertiliser and pests with little data, and buyers cannot verify crop origin or quality.
realtime: Drone and field-sensor data are analysed on arrival; farmers get voice advisories in their language and alerts before pest or water stress spreads.
modules: Crop health and pest detection from drone and satellite imagery
Soil-moisture and micro-climate sensing with TinyML nodes
Voice and chat advisory assistant in Indian languages
Yield and price forecasting for planning and credit
Farm-to-fork traceability on a permissioned blockchain
context: FPOs, agritech start-ups, crop insurance, AgriStack and drone programmes

name: Citizen Services & Urban Operations Command Centre
tagline: Faster public services and safer cities, with privacy by design.
problem: Citizens queue for services and paperwork; city teams monitor traffic, safety and civic issues across thousands of cameras and complaints.
realtime: Video and sensor streams flag incidents and congestion live; a multilingual citizen agent answers questions and tracks applications round the clock.
modules: Multilingual citizen-service agent for applications and grievances
Document AI that reads and verifies certificates and forms
Traffic and crowd video analytics with privacy masking
Grievance clustering and routing to the right department
Responsible-AI controls: consent, bias audits and public transparency reports
context: Smart Cities Mission, e-governance portals, police and traffic control rooms

name: AI Learning, Outcome & Placement Platform
tagline: A personal tutor for every student and live outcome data for every institution.
problem: Large classes leave students behind, OBE and accreditation evidence is compiled by hand, and placement matching is guesswork.
realtime: Every quiz, lab and GitHub commit updates the learner's mastery map; the tutor adapts instantly and dashboards show CO–PO attainment live.
modules: Adaptive AI tutor grounded in the course material, with citations
Automatic CO–PO attainment analytics for NBA and NAAC
Code and lab auto-grading with feedback
Skills-to-jobs matching agent built on this curriculum's careers map
Academic-integrity checks and fair, explainable assessment
context: Universities, NEP 2020 outcome-based education, NBA and NAAC, skilling missions
